column1: # Committed figures that redraw_figures.sh redraws at their committed size from a kit run's handoff RDS,
# with the episode's own chunk code (generated/blocks/<episode>/<label>.R after the episode's setup block).
# Pixel sizes are those of the files in episodes/fig/ (res 300). before: chunks of the same episode run first,
# for figures that need objects the handoff RDS does not hold (- for none). Added 2026-10-22.
# part: which top-level expression of the chunk is the figure, for chunks that draw more than one plot
# (- for the last, as before; 1 for the first). Episode 7 and 8 rows added 2026-10-23 (patch 24, labels from
# seurat_annotations). ep8_umap_split.png is drawn from episode 7's challenge1 chunk: the same DimPlot call as
# episode 8's load-data, which reads the RDS from work_dir and so cannot be redrawn directly.
# Episode 3, 5 and 6 rows added 2026-10-23 (patch 25): the episode 5 and early episode 6 UMAPs were drawn from an
# older run with a different layout, and ep3_scatter-after and ep6_dotplot had transparent backgrounds (png() draws
# on white). ep5_umap-plot is drawn before clustering, so it reruns PCA and UMAP on the r04 object (RunUMAP's fixed
# seed gives the run's layout). ep6_load-data uses episode 5's umap-clusters chunk, the same DimPlot call, because
# episode 6's load-data reads the RDS from work_dir. ep6_dotplot is drawn per cluster, before annotation, so it uses
# the r05 object and reruns episode 6's find-markers and heatmap chunks (about a minute with presto).
